title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
blurb: Simplified mixture-of-experts to top-1 routing with fixed expert capacity and a load-balancing loss, scaling parameter count far beyond compute.
intro: Each token's feed-forward computation goes to one of many experts chosen by a learned router, so parameters grow with the number of experts while FLOPs per token stay fixed. Static shapes force a capacity per expert, which means some tokens can be dropped, and an auxiliary loss keeps the router from collapsing onto a few experts. The steps build routing with load statistics, dispatch and combine, and the communication pattern of expert parallelism; the capstone is a full Switch layer.

steps.name: Capacity-limited routing with balance and z-losses
steps.note: The router z-loss comes from the follow-up ST-MoE paper.
